verdict.rationale: Vast.ai is a GPU cloud marketplace that provides infrastructure, not an AI agent or LLM application that consumes tools. Plugging MCP servers into it as a client is therefore outside its product role. The documented 'vastai agent skill' works in the opposite direction: it lets external coding assistants drive Vast.ai. Nothing in the evidence shows Vast.ai itself acting as an MCP client.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
